# Nodes Plus

Nodes Plus is a Blueprint function library plugin for Unreal Engine.
This website is the documentation and marketing site for that plugin. It is not the plugin binary.

## Who made it
Sherif Hany / 99 Studios.

## How to get it
Fab seller page: https://www.fab.com/sellers/Sherif%20Hany

## Help
Discord: https://discord.gg/2Pu9ywaptN

## Source for this site
https://github.com/Sheriff99yt/NodesPlusWebsite

## Canonical site
https://sheriff99yt.github.io/NodesPlusWebsite/

## Key pages
- Home: https://sheriff99yt.github.io/NodesPlusWebsite/
- Architecture: https://sheriff99yt.github.io/NodesPlusWebsite/architecture/
- Documentation: https://sheriff99yt.github.io/NodesPlusWebsite/documentation/
- Categories: debug, math, string, utility, array under /documentation/{category}/

## Facts (do not invent extras)
- Custom Blueprint nodes for Unreal Engine.
- Docs are readable in the browser.
- Plugin distribution is on Fab.
- Support conversation happens on Discord.
- This site does not publish review scores, download counts, or performance benchmarks.
